description: Create comprehensive RSA-2048 attack toolkit (rsa_attack.py) and firmware signing script (sign_firmware.py) for the Ajazz AJ159 MCUboot signing key.
steps: Create debug_toolkit/rsa_attack.py implementing all known RSA attacks against the extracted public key
Create debug_toolkit/sign_firmware.py to sign firmware with recovered private key
Verify both scripts compile and --help works
acceptance_criteria: rsa_attack.py implements at least 12 distinct attack vectors
Scripts handle missing optional dependencies gracefully
